title: Is mahe moharram me ajab hashr bapa hai
body:
Is mahe moharram me ajab hashr bapa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghar Ghar me mohibbo'n ke Hussaina ki sada hai
<<MINI>>
is mahe moharram me ajab hashr bapa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbal me lahu pyase ka be jurm baha hai
<<MINI>>
Is mahe moharram me ajab hashr bapa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghar Apna sajaakar ke mohib hote hain bechain
romaal liye aati hain shahzadiye kounain
Moula mera phir narga e aada me ghira hai
2. Chahmo me mere ashke aza bandh ke niyyat
<<DIVIDER>>
is saal bhi rehjaaye no koi inhe'n hasrat
hijrat ke liye baandh ke samaane aza hai
3. Is maah me Shabbir(a.s) ne sar apna kataaya
gurbat me musafir ne kafan bhi nahi paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jangal me chaman hazrate Zehra(s.a) ka luta hai
4. Jab chand moharram ka sare arsh hai aaya
Dil thaam ke bimaar ne salma ko bulaaya
Kehne lagi baba mera pabande buka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Cheh maah ki muddat hui ab tak nahi aaye
us dasht me baba pa mere aanch na aaye
tujhse mere malik meri bas ek dua hai
6. Paani ki talab aur bhi badh jaati thi usdam
<<DIVIDER>>
Sooraj ki tapish jismo'n ko julasti thi usdam
Aise me Qayaamat hai ke baccho'n pa jafa hai
7.
Farmaan
<<DIVIDER>>
lahad apni sitaro'n se sajaakar phir farse aza ashko'n ki chadar ko banaakar
lo shaah e shahidaan pa rone ko chala hai
Kalaam : Janaab Mohibbe Abid Abidi Sahab (Farmaan)
